protocol.answer_absence_rule: serialized target and all state values absent from read_prompt
protocol.donor_rule: all four target keys retained; every semantic value factor transferred from a distinct external component
protocol.pristine_base_rule: load the frozen Gemma base without attaching the memory adapter
protocol.read_cache_rule: read prompt is address only; trainer must preserve outer state and disable writes
protocol.source_hash_scope: record_payload_sha256 hashes JSON records only and is never runtime tensor-state evidence
protocol.target_rewrite_rule: only queried slot changes; alternate chosen outside donor and swap values when label cardinality permits
protocol.value_swap_rule: derangement of in-episode semantic value factors; every destination value changes
protocol.write_scope: one natural key/value record per write; no cross-record text
